model_output:
```sql
WITH casnovia_township AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Casnovia Township'
    AND border_type ILIKE 'township'
    AND addr_state ILIKE 'Michigan'
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(rast, (SELECT geom FROM casnovia_township), true) AS clipped_raster
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geom FROM casnovia_township))
)
SELECT MIN((ST_Value(clipped_raster, 1))::float) AS lowest_elevation
FROM clipped_dem;
```
